intent: Select the peaks from peaks.bed that overlap at least one promoter in promoters.bed and keep their original records for a promoter-versus-distal comparison. Both files are already sorted with sort-bed.
silent_error: bedops --element-of without a number uses its default of 100%: a peak is kept only if all of its bases are covered by the promoter file. Peaks that overlap a promoter by part of their length (peak_01, peak_04) are dropped without any message, so the promoter-bound set shrinks from 4 peaks to 2 and the distal set is contaminated with promoter peaks. The output is a normal sorted BED subset with exit 0. The bedops usage text states it: '-e, --element-of [bp | percentage] ... by default, -e 100% is used. bedops -e 1 is also popular.'
